Consumer Finance Terms (Purchase of Goods)

tables.title: Consumer Finance Terms (Purchase of Goods)

cells: Citizens and non-citizens of Armenia who are resident in Armenia1

If applying at the seller’s premises (hereinafter “the Company”)
Mobile phone/computer equipment: AMD 50,000 - AMD 1,000,000
Household appliances: AMD 50,000 - AMD 3,600,000
Furniture, construction materials, home improvement products and heating systems: AMD 50,000 - AMD 6,000,000
Household items, spare parts for cars and other goods: AMD 50,000 - AMD 2,400,000
If applying online via the Company’s website (irrespective of the product): AMD 50,000 - AMD 1,000,000

6-60. A term exceeding 48 months may be set only in case of furniture, construction materials, home improvement products and heating systems.
If applying online via the Company’s website (irrespective of the product): 6-36 months

Fixed
As specified in the Cooperation Agreement between the Company and the Bank
As specified in the Cooperation Agreement between the Company and the Bank
As specified in the Cooperation Agreement between the Company and the Bank

1. Annuity (equal monthly installments consisting of a portion of debt and a portion of interest) where interest rate is applied
2. Equal monthly installments schedule (equal monthly installments consisting of a portion of debt and a portion of fee) where a fee is applied
The purchased item serves as a collateral.

• Identity document
• Public services number (social card)
Late payment fines and penalties (principal and interest)

In case of breach of the due date under the agreement, the Client shall pay to the Bank a fine
• In the amount of 0.13% of overdue amount and interest for each day of delay
• No fines and penalties are applied in case of prepayment.
Fee for the service, payment of interest and other charges
In case of payment via the Bank’s remote banking system
Fee for the service, payment of interest and other charges
If paid via payment terminals and ATMs owned by the Bank
According to the Terms and Conditions of Transactions through Payment Terminals (11RBD/12CIB PL 72-16)2
Fee for the service, payment of interest and other charges
If paid via payment terminals owned by other companies
According to the tariffs of the respective company
Fee for the service, payment of interest and other charges
If paid at the Bank’s branches
According to Ameriabank CJSC Tariffs for Individuals (11RBD PL 72-01-01)3.
As specified in the Cooperation Agreement between the Company and the Bank

notes: 1 Individuals resident in Armenia (hereinafter referred to as “resident individuals”) are those individuals who have been actually resident in the Republic of Armenia for 183 and more days during the tax year (Tax Code, Article 25).

2 Ameriabank CJSC Terms and Conditions of Transactions through Payment Terminals (11RBD/12CIB PL 72-16), approved by Management Board Resolution # 01/110/15 as of September 4, 2015). Available at https://ameriabank.am/useful-links.
